Both editions offer a scalable, serverless, and fully managed eventing solution that lets you asynchronously route messages from sources to targets using loosely coupled services that are triggered by and react to state changes known as events. Both editions support a range of event providers and destinations—including Google Cloud services, custom applications, SaaS applications, and third-party services—while managing delivery, security, authorization, observability, and error-handling for you.
